comment: Reviewed identity of the runtime assets provisioned separately under <Local AppData>/Qronos/RuntimeAssets (never bundled in the installer). 'verified' entries match an official publisher's own published size and SHA-256 (Hugging Face LFS oid, or the official release file re-downloaded and hashed); their licence notes are the publisher's text. 'unverified' entries have NO published identity matching the local file and therefore NO hash here (a local hash is not provenance); 'missing' entries are configured but absent. build_support/runtime_assets.py checks an asset folder against this file read-only. Changing an entry is a reviewed change; never edit a hash to match another file.

assets.evidence: official v0.5.1 release asset re-downloaded 2026-10-12 and hashed; size equals the GitHub release API size (no API digest published)
